name: Zhu Hanping
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder, Hubei Sanfeng Intelligent Conveying Equipment (Sanfeng Intelligent, SZ:300276)
profile: Zhu Hanping founded Sanfeng Intelligent in 1999, a maker of intelligent conveying/automation equipment that listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext board in 2011. He is the company's legal representative, chairman and holds roughly 40% of its shares.
interesting_fact: A 2019 Shanghai Securities News profile described him as having stuck with manufacturing for 20 years, saying that after earning some money working for others he wanted to build a Chinese industrial company.
notes: Alive status not explicitly confirmed; sources indicate he still controls the company as of 2026 data. Shares wealth with Zhu Zhe. Best route likely via company board secretary/IR of Sanfeng Intelligent (300276).

name: Paul J Fribourg
current_role: Executive Chairman, Continental Grain Company (Conti); director of Loews, Estee Lauder and IFF
profile: Paul Fribourg is the sixth generation of his family to lead Continental Grain, the agribusiness and investment firm founded in Arlon, Belgium in 1813. He joined in 1976, ran European operations 1980-85, became chairman and CEO in 1997, and has recently transitioned to executive chairman.
interesting_fact: On stepping back as CEO he said: 'After 50 years and at age 72, it's time to turn things over to the next generation of leadership.'
deep_cut_fact: Before running the company he served as General Manager of Continental Grain's European operations from 1980 to 1985, after starting in merchandising roles in the US in 1976.
notes: Amherst College graduate; Council on Foreign Relations member. Wikipedia's 'CEO since 1976' is likely wrong (joined 1976, CEO from 1997).

name: Kwok Siu Ming
current_role: Chairman and CEO, Sa Sa International Holdings (HKEX:178)
profile: Dr Simon Kwok Siu Ming co-founded Sa Sa with his wife Eleanor Kwok in 1978, starting from a 40 sq ft cosmetics counter in Causeway Bay. He built it into a major Asian beauty retail chain, listed in Hong Kong in 1997, and remains chairman and CEO per the 2025/26 annual report.
interesting_fact: He was named Business Person of the Year at the DHL/SCMP Hong Kong Business Awards 2018.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Sa Sa he worked as a parking meter repairman; the first shop was a basement unit in President Shopping Centre on Jaffe Road, Causeway Bay.
notes: Also known as a racehorse owner (Royal Ascot owner profile exists). Wife Eleanor Kwok is vice-chairman.
